note:
Emma Taylor, a widow living on her own means, with her two grown daughters, a young visitor and two servants at 11 Newcastle Drive (#213) on the 1891 return, transcribed by A. Hagues. None of the six was in the record, and 11 Newcastle Drive held only 1921 (the Topham household), so 1891 is free.

She had left within seven years: Wright's Directory prints 'Miss Louisa H. Topham; Joseph R. Topham, of J. R. Tpm & Bro.' at number 11 in 1898-99, and Joseph R. Topham holds it through 1915-16 and is there on the 1921 return. There is no 1894-95 line for the number, so nothing places her after this census.

Several Taylors are already in the record - at Castlethorpe, 9 Hamilton Drive, 43 Lenton Road and Fairlawn - and none matches this widow or her daughters on name and year together, so all three are created new. Kate Gladys King, the ten-year-old visitor from Bath, is joined to nobody: the return gives no relationship beyond visitor. Ages are as the enumerator wrote them, so a birth year worked back from one may be a year out either way. **A caution on the street numbering.** Newcastle Drive was formerly named Pelham Terrace, as seventeen listed-building descriptions in the record state, and A. Hagues finds 1891 schedules headed 'Newcastle Drive, Pelham Terrace' and others headed Pelham Terrace alone; a published account of 15 Newcastle Drive calls it 'originally 24 Pelham Terrace', which no simple renumbering of this street explains. So an 1891 number may be a Pelham Terrace number rather than a Newcastle Drive one. Five houses on this street are safe, because the 1894-95 directory prints the same householder at the same number as the census - 1 Cartwright, 3 Stevens, 5 Hill, 9 Wright, 13 Kidd. **This house is not one of them**, so its number rests on the census alone and should be checked before it is relied on. See [[newcastle-drive-pelham-terrace-numbers]].
source: 1891 census, 11 Newcastle Drive, transcribed by A. Hagues. Directory evidence: Wright's Directory of Nottingham 1898-99, page 109 (Leicester Special Collections id 165285).
